collections: HLSL30 v2.0 (C2021957657-LPCLOUD), HLSS30 v2.0 (C2021957295-LPCLOUD): B04/B03/B02 for RGB chips

season.label: 2024 reference season (summer harvest to the following spring)

meta.cleanRule: Pixel centre inside a parcel after a 30 m inward buffer; Fmask cloud, adjacent to cloud/shadow, cloud shadow, snow/ice and water bits all 0; aerosol level not 'high'; NDVI not fill (-19999).

chipGrid.crs: EPSG:32619 (HLS tile grid, UTM zone 19, negative northing)
chipGrid.note: Chip corners from the tile transform. Shown on a Web Mercator map as an axis-aligned overlay; grid rotation at this longitude shifts corners by less than half a pixel.
